I have a problem with the TEST "Two companies".
"Fast food" has a fire wall strength of 3. This creates the following passing conditions:
Portscan: Always
Bruteforce: Strength >= 500
Malware Installation: Strength >= 1000

Since there is no bruteforce attack with a strength of 500 or higher, a brute force attack will not succeed and therefore no malware installation can happen. This company can not be hacked with these attacks.

There is a similar problem with the TEST "Many companies many Cyberattacks".
"Mamounia hotel" has a fire wall strength of 2. This creates the following passing conditions:
Portscan: Always
Bruteforce: Strength >= 500
Malware Installation: Strength >= 1000

Since there is no malware installation attempt with a strength of 1000 or higher, a brute force attack will not succeed. This company can not be hacked with these attacks.

Can you please explain?

I got it all working on 1 validator part left:
Mamounia Hotel in Many companies many Cyberattacks
Can you explain why its not blocked. ?
protection is less then 5 and mi never exceeds 1000

Hi Phykin, 
Thank you for highlighting this! The reason Fast food and Mamounia Hotel succeeded is that attacks of the same type against the same company are cumulative (summed together):For Fast food (fw=3): bf:80 + bf:499 = 579 ($\ge 500$), then mi:1005 ($\ge 1000$), so the attack chain succeeds.For Mamounia hotel (fw=2): bf:1005 ($\ge 500$), and mi:20 + mi:985 = 1005 ($\ge 1000$), so the malware installation succeeds as well.I have updated the statement to explicitly state that attack strengths of the same type must be summed. Thank you for helping make the rules crystal clear!

I think this game has as much to do with cybersecurity, as Code Golf has with golf. I don't think this has anything to do with actual hacking and I don't think it has anything to do with professionalism of hackers or Sysadmins...
